title: The merge tool clears a cancelled scheduled run on an older main once a newer run passed
why: Batch 65 (PR #1090), Nov 2 06:18 CST: the merge tool read main as unknown from scheduled run 41434991174 on old main 4477f7e3, cancelled with no red job, while main's head 07f855dc was green (run 41437045856). A re-run cleared it. Likely to recur: scheduled runs get cancelled often, and q_max PR #1011's cancelled browser run (page item 154) is the same shape.
note: Fix to weigh: a cancelled run with no red job, on a commit older than main's head, clears when a newer completed run of the same workflow passed the same jobs; the same rule PR #1067 built for red runs. Red first: a fixture with that cancelled older run and a green newer run merges; a cancelled run on main's head stays unknown. Related step merge-ignores-superseded-runs (same idea on the PR head). Basis: named incident (batch 65, coordinator Nov 2 07:18 CST). Port: yes, the merge tool is shared. Ready.
